Jordan (Acme): Hey, after our IdP cert rotation (today ~08:05 UTC) SAML SSO is failing for a subset of users. They hit /saml/callback -> 403 with 'Recipient invalid' or sometimes 'Invalid signature'. Works for others. Any quick help?

Meera: Hi Jordan — sorry about that. Can you paste an example SAMLResponse (redact the SSO payload) or an SP error log? Also, what exact ACS URL is configured in the IdP?

Jordan (Acme): ACS we registered: https://app.acme.com/sso/acs;jsessionid=XYZ?tenant=acme (we use a jsessionid path param + query). SAMLResponse (redacted) attached.

Jordan (Acme): ```-----BEGIN SAMLResponse-----
REDACTED
-----END SAMLResponse-----```
IdP metadata URL: https://login.microsoftonline.com/abcd/federationmetadata/2007-06/federationmetadata.xml

Nik: jumping in. Quick triage notes: the metadata you're hitting contains duplicate EntityDescriptor entries for the same entityID (IdP served two descriptors). In one of them the KeyDescriptor ordering still lists the old signing cert first. Our SP tends to pick the first compatible KeyDescriptor, which can produce intermittent signature validation failures when the IdP rotates and serves both keys.
Also: the ACS includes a semicolon path parameter (`;jsessionid=...`) plus query params. Some edge proxies or redirect handlers will normalize or drop path params when doing a GET redirect (Redirect binding), which can make the ACS mismatch on callback. Mobile browsers and some CDN rewrites are common culprits.

Meera: so two possible failure modes — (1) signature mismatches because SP picks the wrong ordering of KeyDescriptors, and (2) ACS URL normalization/stripping during Redirect binding. Short-term options: 
  • Ask IdP to publish metadata with a single EntityDescriptor per entityID or ensure the active key has `use=\"signing\"` set and appears first.
  • Move that ACS to HTTP-POST binding in the IdP (avoid RelayState + query via redirect).
  • We can force a metadata reload on our side so the rotated key ordering is fetched immediately.

Meera: Jordan — want us to force-reload your metadata now (we can also enable a fallback try of multiple KeyDescriptors while we patch)?

Jordan (Acme): yes please reload now, customers stuck.

deploy-bot: metadata reload triggered for tenant `acme` by Meera — job id=7892 started.

Nik: reload finished. We also pushed a temporary fallback so if signature validation fails using the first KeyDescriptor we attempt the next matching KeyDescriptor to reduce user impact. Please test logins now.

Jordan (Acme): testing — good news, majority of desktop users can login now. Mobile webflows still fail intermittently (same users fail 30% of attempts).

Meera: that matches the Redirect-binding hypothesis. Mobile flows often get routed through a mobile CDN that strips path params or rewrites semicolons. Recommended: switch the ACS to POST binding for mobile user profiles or remove the `;jsessionid` path param (use a cookie or clean path + query).

Jordan (Acme): we'll switch to POST binding and drop the semicolon path param. ETA ~2 hours.

Rachel (ops): scheduling a follow-up with the IdP contact and internal postmortem. We should add an automated check that flags duplicate EntityDescriptor entries and missing `use=\"signing\"` on keys before future rotations. @Nik can you own the test?

Nik: yep — I'll add a CI check that validates metadata has a single EntityDescriptor per entityID and that there's an explicit `use=\"signing\"` for the active key. Will also add a small integration test exercising POST vs Redirect for ACS. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Acme): thanks all :pray: We'll confirm after we flip to POST.

Meera: closing loop for now — reopen thread if anything persists. :white_check_mark:
